The '''probability projection computer''' was a type of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] used by [[Droid/Legends|droids]].It allowed them to calculate the probability of an event occurring.<ref name="EGTD" /> [[FLR-series Logger Droid]] used probability projection computers to determine where and how a tree would fall when cut.<ref name="J6">{{JournalCite|6|The Greel Wood Haven}}</ref> [[Hound-W2 SPD]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] used probability projection computers for assistance during criminal search procedures,<ref name="J14">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref> and to determine the possible origins of innocuous trace elements.<ref name="EGTD" />
